overview.zh: 加密与AI资本同步加速：Solana完成共识升级，OpenAI与DeepSeek大额融资推进，链上资产与AI基础设施边界持续扩张。 公链性能：Solana主网激活Alpenglow，区块最终确定时间由约12.8秒缩短至约150毫秒。 AI融资：OpenAI寻求以1.25万亿美元投前估值筹集最多300亿美元，目标下周前签署协议。 链上资产：Morpho上线Robinhood股票代币抵押借贷，OKX阿联酋在VARA牌照下推出7×24小时代币化美股交易。
overview.en: Crypto and AI capital accelerate together as Solana ships its consensus overhaul and OpenAI and DeepSeek pursue large raises. Chain performance：Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, cutting block finality from roughly 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds. AI funding：OpenAI is seeking up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation and aims to sign agreements by next week. Tokenized assets：Morpho enabled stablecoin borrowing against Robinhood stock tokens, while OKX UAE launched 24/7 tokenized US stock trading under VARA.

title.zh: CVE-2026-111943：中间证书颁发机构遭攻陷

summary.zh:
美国国家标准与技术研究院的国家漏洞数据库发布了 CVE-2026-111943，针对 eMudhra 中间证书颁发机构证书遭攻陷一事。此前，Mozilla 与谷歌 Chrome 根证书计划于 2026 年 10 月 20 日确认，eMudhra 的 8 个中间证书的私钥可以直接从公开证书中还原。Chrome 随后将 emSign ECC Root CA - G3 从 Chrome 根证书库中移除，以保护那些不接收 CRLSet 更新的使用方。

由于任何人都能从公开材料中推导出这些私钥，攻击者可以伪造出对任意域名都看似有效的证书，冒充银行、GitHub 或 PyPI 等站点，这迫使操作系统和浏览器厂商紧急推送信任库更新。

eMudhra 在事件声明中表示，受影响的中间证书是在 2025 年 4 月的一次密钥生成仪式中创建的，其根 CA 私钥和其他中间证书颁发机构未受影响，并称未签发任何终端实体证书。Mozilla 表示已在 UTC 21:48 独立还原出受影响证书的私钥，确认密钥生成过程存在缺陷且极易被利用。
summary.en:
NIST's National Vulnerability Database published CVE-2026-111943 for a compromise of eMudhra intermediate certificate authority certificates, after Mozilla and Google's Chrome Root Program confirmed on October 20, 2026 that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediates could be recovered directly from their public certificates. Chrome responded by removing emSign ECC Root CA - G3 from the Chrome Root Store to protect consumers that do not take CRLSet updates.

Because the private keys can be derived by anyone from public material, an attacker could mint a certificate that appears valid for any domain and impersonate sites such as banks, GitHub or PyPI, forcing operating system and browser vendors to push emergency trust-store updates.

eMudhra said in its incident statement that the affected intermediates were created during a key-generation ceremony in April 2025 and that its root CA private keys and other intermediate authorities were not affected, adding that no end-entity certificates were issued. Mozilla reported that it independently recovered the private keys for the impacted certificates at 21:48 UTC, confirming the key-generation process was flawed and trivial to exploit.

title.zh: Solana 自 2020 年以来最大的网络变革已上线。以下是用户将如何受益
title.en: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit

summary.zh:
Solana 已在主网激活 Alpenglow 共识升级，用 Votor 替换原有的 TowerBFT 共识机制，并用 Rotor 替换 Turbine 区块传播协议。此次变更将区块最终确定时间从约 12.8 秒缩短至约 150 毫秒。

据 Solana 介绍，Alpenglow 是该网络自 TowerBFT 以来首次重大共识替换，改变了验证者的投票方式以及区块达成最终确定的方式。最终确定时间从约 12.8 秒降至约 150 毫秒，直接缩短了网络上的交易确认等待时间。

Solana 表示，此次升级不改动交易执行和 SVM，只改变与共识相关的机制以及共识信息向下游基础设施的暴露方式。Rotor 与 Turbine 一样，会将每个区块通过纠删码拆分为更小的“碎片”（shreds），并可从其中一部分碎片重建完整区块。
summary.en:
Solana activated its Alpenglow consensus overhaul on mainnet, replacing the TowerBFT consensus mechanism with Votor and the Turbine block-propagation protocol with Rotor. The change cuts block finality from roughly 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds.

According to Solana, Alpenglow is the network's first major consensus replacement since TowerBFT, changing how validators vote and how blocks reach finality. A finality time of roughly 150 milliseconds instead of about 12.8 seconds directly shortens the wait for transaction confirmation on the network.

Solana states the upgrade leaves transaction execution and the SVM unchanged, altering only consensus-related mechanics and how consensus information is exposed to downstream infrastructure. Rotor, like Turbine, erasure-codes each block into smaller "shreds" that can be reconstructed from a subset.

title.zh: OpenAI接近完成新一轮融资，寻求以1.25万亿美元投前估值筹集最多300亿美元资金
title.en: OpenAI Nears Close of New Funding Round, Seeking Up to $30 Billion at a $1.25 Trillion Pre-Money Valuation

summary.zh:
据 CNBC 报道，OpenAI 正接近完成新一轮融资，寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值筹集最多 300 亿美元资金，来自阿联酋的投资者与投资机构 Coatue 共同领投。知情人士称，OpenAI 于周四向投资者表示计划在下周结束前完成协议签署，但本轮融资的最终规模仍在确定之中。

若本轮融资使 OpenAI 的估值突破 1 万亿美元，其将成为有史以来估值最高的私营公司。公司将此次融资定位为潜在 IPO 前的一笔「机会型过桥融资」。

1.25 万亿美元为投前估值，即不包含本轮新筹集的资金。OpenAI 同时还在就一项商业协议进行谈判，计划从阿联酋获得更多算力资源；首席财务官萨拉·弗莱尔此前已向员工表示，公司可能于 2027 年上市。
summary.en:
OpenAI is nearing the close of a new funding round in which it is seeking to raise up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with investors from the UAE co-leading alongside investment firm Coatue, according to CNBC-sourced reports. OpenAI told investors on Thursday that it aims to sign the agreements by the end of next week, though the final size of the round is still being determined.

Should the round price OpenAI above a $1 trillion valuation, it would become the most highly valued private company on record. The company is positioning the raise as an "opportunistic bridge financing" ahead of a possible initial public offering.

The $1.25 trillion figure is a pre-money valuation, meaning it excludes the new capital being raised. OpenAI also is negotiating a commercial agreement to obtain additional computing resources from the UAE, and CFO Sarah Friar has previously told employees the company could list in 2027.

title.zh: 据报道 DeepSeek 在美国限制措施出台数日后融资 150 亿美元
title.en: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions

summary.zh:
TechCrunch 于 2026 年 10 月 22 日报道，DeepSeek 已融资 150 亿美元，被称为中国规模最大的融资轮之一，而此事发生在美国下令联邦机构移除其技术仅数日之后。该报道以“据报道”形式呈现，融资条款与投资方名单均未披露。

这一时点使该融资报道与华盛顿以国家安全为由对 DeepSeek 技术施加的限制形成直接对照；在国土安全部下达移除令后，中国政府已对此表示反对。

该报道未披露估值、投资方身份，也未说明融资是否已完成交割。此前关于 DeepSeek 融资的报道给出的数字并不一致，其中包括寻求 73.5 亿美元融资的说法，说明各家媒体所报道的总额存在出入。
summary.en:
TechCrunch reported on October 22, 2026 that DeepSeek has raised $15 billion, described as one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology. The report is framed as unconfirmed, and the round's terms and investor list were not disclosed.

The timing puts the reported raise directly against Washington's national-security restrictions on DeepSeek's technology, a contrast China's government has already pushed back on after the Homeland Security Department's removal order.

The report did not disclose valuation, investor identities or whether the round has closed. Earlier coverage of DeepSeek fundraising described different figures, including a sought $7.35 billion round, indicating that reported totals have varied across outlets.

title.zh: 美国悄然放宽稳定币储备规则，银行警告数千亿美元资金可能撤离放贷业务
title.en: US quietly eases stablecoin reserve rules as banks warn billions could shift away from lending

summary.zh:
美国货币监理署（OCC）在银行界的反对声中放宽了稳定币储备规则，银行此前一直寻求设置防止存款外流的保障条款。银行业警告称，这一调整可能使数千亿美元存款从传统放贷业务流入稳定币储备。

该规则决定了稳定币发行方必须以何种资产为其流通中的代币提供支撑，银行界认为更宽松的标准会使存款更容易从放贷流向储备资产。

这一调整并未高调公开推出，报道将其描述为取消了银行此前要求的防止存款外流的保障措施。
summary.en:
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has eased stablecoin reserve rules over objections from banks, which had sought safeguards against deposit flight. Banking groups warn the change could move billions of dollars of deposits out of traditional lending and into stablecoin reserves.

The rule determines what assets stablecoin issuers must hold against tokens in circulation, and bank groups argue looser standards make it easier for deposits to migrate from lending into reserve holdings.

The change was made without a prominent public rollout, and the reporting frames it as the removal of safeguards banks had requested against deposit flight.

title.zh: 【Morpho 支持以 Robinhood 股票代币为抵押品借入稳定币】
title.en: Morpho Supports Borrowing Stablecoins Against Robinhood Stock Tokens as Collateral

summary.zh:
10 月 22 日，借贷协议 Morpho 宣布 Robinhood 股票代币已在其平台上线，用户可将股票代币作为抵押品借入稳定币。Morpho 提供底层信贷网络，Robinhood Crypto 旗下的 Robinhood Chain 提供代币化基础设施，任何应用均可接入面向股票代币的借贷市场。

该集成把链上信贷市场的抵押品范围扩展到代币化股票，超出了 DeFi 借贷通常接受的加密原生资产范畴。

Morpho 在其中的角色是信贷层而非代币化层，股票代币的发行与结算由 Robinhood Chain 承担。公告未披露具体支持哪些股票、抵押率，以及已有哪些应用完成接入。
summary.en:
Morpho announced on October 22 that Robinhood stock tokens are now live on its platform, allowing users to post tokenized equities as collateral and borrow stablecoins against them. Morpho supplies the underlying credit network while Robinhood Chain provides the tokenization infrastructure, and any application can integrate the resulting lending markets.

The integration extends on-chain credit markets to tokenized equity collateral, a step beyond the crypto-native assets that typically back DeFi loans.

Morpho positions itself as the credit layer rather than the tokenization layer, leaving issuance and settlement of the stock tokens to Robinhood Chain. The announcement did not specify which equities are supported, collateral ratios, or which applications have integrated the markets.

title.zh: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】
title.en: Uniswap Aggregator Hooks Go Live, Wrapping External Liquidity Sources Into v4 Pools

summary.zh:
Uniswap Labs 于 10 月 22 日发文称，Aggregator Hooks 现已上线，Uniswap v4 由此具备聚合功能：该机制通过 Hook 将外部流动性来源包装成 v4 池，任何路由均可将其视为 Uniswap 池。该功能已在以太坊主网、Base 与 Robinhood Chain 的 Uniswap 网页端与 API 上线，更多网络将陆续接入；上线首日支持七个外部来源，包括 Curve、Fluid 与 PancakeSwap。

Uniswap 表示，大部分链上流动性已在 Uniswap，但新流动性仍可能出现在其他场所；把外部来源纳入 v4 后，Uniswap 与独立 DEX 聚合器的竞争更为直接。经外部来源路由的兑换将缴纳协议费，并贡献于 UNI 销毁，从而把聚合交易量与 UNI 供应连接起来。

每区块路由会从已接入来源拉取最新报价，在 Uniswap 池与外部来源之间构建最优路径，并在单笔交易内完成结算，无需新增授权。BlockBeats 于 10 月 22 日报道了此次上线。
summary.en:
Uniswap Labs said in an Oct. 22 post that Aggregator Hooks are now live, making Uniswap v4 function as an aggregator by wrapping external liquidity sources into v4 pools that any router can treat as a Uniswap pool. The feature is available in the Uniswap Web app and API on Ethereum mainnet, Base and Robinhood Chain, with more chains to follow and seven liquidity sources at launch, including Curve, Fluid and PancakeSwap.

Uniswap said most onchain liquidity already sits on Uniswap but new liquidity can still emerge elsewhere, so folding external venues into v4 puts it in more direct competition with standalone DEX aggregators. Swaps routed through those external sources pay the protocol fee and contribute to UNI burn, linking aggregator volume to UNI supply.

Per block, the router pulls the latest quotes from integrated sources, builds the best path between Uniswap pools and external venues, and settles within a single transaction without requiring new approvals. BlockBeats reported the launch on Oct. 22.

title.zh: SoFi 面向加密用户推出计息、受 FDIC 保险保障的代币化存款
title.en: SoFi launches interest-bearing, FDIC-insured tokenized deposit for crypto users

summary.zh:
SoFi Technologies 于周四推出 SoFi Earn（代码 SOFIE），这是由 SoFi Bank 发行的代币化存款，提供 4.40% 的可变年化收益率，无最低余额要求，并在每位存款人、每家受保银行、每个账户所有权类别 25 万美元限额内获得 FDIC 保险保障。SoFi 称这是美国国民银行首次直接面向个人客户提供代币化存款，并预计 11 月完成向 SoFi Crypto 会员的全面上线。

每枚 SOFIE 对应 SoFi Bank 的 1 美元存款，可按 1:1 兑换为该行的美元挂钩稳定币 SoFiUSD，用于在应用内购买加密资产或转至支持的外部钱包，为加密用户在动用资金之前持有闲置美元提供了一种银行背书且受存款保险保障的方式。

SOFIE 存款在兑换前持续计息，而 SoFiUSD 与其他稳定币一样，本身并不属于受 FDIC 保险保障的存款。会员通过其独立的 SoFi Crypto 账户访问该 SOFIE 存款账户。
summary.en:
SoFi Technologies on Thursday launched SoFi Earn (ticker SOFIE), a tokenized deposit issued by SoFi Bank that pays a variable 4.40% annual percentage yield, carries no minimum balance requirement, and qualifies for FDIC coverage up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each account ownership category. SoFi describes it as the first tokenized deposit offered directly to consumers by a US national bank and expects the rollout to SoFi Crypto members to be completed in November.

Each SOFIE corresponds to $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank and can be converted one-for-one into SoFiUSD, the bank's dollar-pegged stablecoin, to buy crypto in the app or send to supported external wallets — giving crypto users a bank-backed, deposit-insured way to hold idle dollars before they are deployed.

SOFIE deposits continue to earn interest until they are converted, whereas SoFiUSD itself, like other stablecoins, is not an FDIC-insured deposit. Members reach the separate SOFIE deposit account through their SoFi Crypto account.

title.zh: CoinDCX再回应1580万美元用户存款去向不明：旧地址此前已遭弃用，运营损失由平台承担
title.en: CoinDCX Responds Again to Unaccounted $15.8 Million in User Deposits: Deprecated Address Was Long Abandoned, Operational Losses Borne by Platform

summary.zh:
10月22日，印度加密交易平台CoinDCX再次就存款地址TQKJQ的链上争议作出回应，称该地址在2025年7月安全事件后已被入侵并弃用，但仍有用户继续向其转入资金。平台表示其常规扫款流程在某一时段失效，问题于当日上午发现，由此产生的运营损失由CoinDCX自行承担，相关用户存款均已完成入账。

CoinDCX称受影响用户存款已全部入账，资金仍存放于隔离冷钱包，活跃钱包中的平台资金亦未被盗，从而将该事件对用户的直接冲击限制在平台自述的“运营失误”范围内。

平台称现行中心化地址与用户地址均未受影响，交易与平台运营照常进行。对于约1580万美元在较长时间内去向不明的原因，CoinDCX未作具体说明。
summary.en:
On Oct. 22, India-based exchange CoinDCX again addressed on-chain controversy over deposit address TQKJQ, saying the address was compromised and deprecated after its July 2025 security incident and that users kept sending funds to it anyway. The exchange said its routine sweep process failed for a period, the failure was discovered that morning, and the resulting operational losses will be absorbed by CoinDCX, while all affected deposits were credited to users.

CoinDCX says affected users were fully credited and that funds remain in segregated cold wallets, with no loss of platform funds in active wallets — limiting direct user impact from an incident it otherwise describes as an operational failure.

The exchange said current centralized and user addresses are unaffected and that trading and platform operations continue as normal. It did not detail how roughly $15.8 million went unaccounted for over an extended period.

title.zh: OKX 阿联酋在 VARA 牌照下推出 24/7 代币化美股交易
title.en: OKX UAE Launches Tokenised US Stocks with 24/7 Trading on VARA Licence

summary.zh:
OKX 的阿联酋实体已推出代币化美股交易，支持每周 7 天、每天 24 小时不间断交易，并在迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）颁发的牌照下运营。该产品把受监管的、类加密风格的市场准入扩展到了美股敞口。

由 VARA 持牌平台提供全天候代币化股票敞口，意味着在加密行业监管体系较为完善的司法辖区之一，代币化证券的可及性进一步扩大，股票敞口也获得了与加密交易同等的 7×24 小时交易安排。

代币化股票是基于区块链发行的代币，旨在反映某只具体股票的价值。另有关于 OKX 更广泛代币化证券计划的报道提到，相关交易以 USDC、USDG 和 USDT 等稳定币计价，并通过 OKX 二层网络 XLayer 上经许可的 Uniswap v4 流动性池进行。
summary.en:
OKX's UAE entity has launched tokenised US stock trading that is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, operating under its licence from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA). The offering extends regulated, crypto-style market access to US equity exposure.

A VARA-licensed venue offering round-the-clock tokenised equity exposure widens access to tokenised securities in one of the crypto industry's more developed regulatory jurisdictions, putting equity exposure on the same always-on footing as crypto trading.

Tokenised stocks are blockchain-based tokens designed to reflect the value of a specific equity. Separate reporting on OKX's broader tokenised-equity plans describes trading against stablecoins including USDC, USDG and USDT through permissioned Uniswap v4 liquidity pools on XLayer, OKX's layer-2 blockchain.

title.zh: Polkadot 基金会警告 Fearless Wallet 浏览器扩展泄露私钥

summary.zh:
Polkadot 基金会发布警告称，Fearless Wallet 浏览器扩展泄露了用户的私钥，受影响钱包存在被入侵的风险。该警告直接点名了这款 Polkadot 生态的第三方钱包。

私钥是钱包发起转账的授权凭证，因此任何拿到泄露私钥的人都可以在无需所有者进一步批准的情况下转走对应资金。

Fearless Wallet 浏览器扩展面向 Kusama 和 Polkadot 网络，通过 Chrome 应用商店分发给 Chrome 及基于 Chromium 的浏览器用户。就目前报道的警告内容而言，并未包含已确认的损失金额、漏洞利用规模或受影响用户数量。
summary.en:
The Polkadot Foundation issued a warning that the Fearless Wallet browser extension leaked users' private keys, leaving affected wallets exposed to compromise. The warning names the third-party Polkadot-ecosystem wallet directly.

Private keys are what authorize transfers from a wallet, so anyone holding a leaked key can move the associated funds without further approval from the owner.

Fearless Wallet's browser extension is built for the Kusama and Polkadot networks and distributed through the Chrome Web Store for Chrome and Chromium-based browsers. The warning as reported did not include confirmed loss figures, exploit scale, or the number of affected users.

title.zh: 微软称其AI工具在诊断疾病方面优于医生
title.en: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions

summary.zh:
微软AI部门首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼宣布推出一款新的AI诊断系统，公司称其在诊断疾病方面比人类医生的准确率最高可达四倍。该说法基于2026年10月22日发表在《Science》上的同行评审研究。

该结果发表在同行评审期刊而非公司演示中，使微软的说法比一般产品发布更具分量。不过，对照对象是在疑难病例上的一般内科医生，而非专科医生。

微软该系统被称为“诊断编排器”（MAI-DxO），在《Science》研究中报告的准确率为83.2%。相关报道指出，性能提升的很大一部分似乎来自底层AI模型，而非微软的系统本身。
summary.en:
Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic system that the company says can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human physicians. The claim is based on a peer-reviewed study published in Science on October 22, 2026.

The result appeared in a peer-reviewed journal rather than a company demo, which gives Microsoft's claim more weight than a typical product announcement. The comparison, however, was against generalist physicians on difficult cases, not specialist doctors.

Microsoft's system, described as a diagnostic orchestrator (MAI-DxO), was reported at 83.2% accuracy in the Science study. Coverage notes that much of the improvement appears to come from the underlying AI models rather than from Microsoft's system itself.

title.zh: Dune 推出覆盖 200 个链上交易场所的实时数据源
title.en: Dune launches real-time data feeds covering 200 onchain trading venues

summary.zh:
Dune 于周四宣布推出实时市场数据源，覆盖以太坊、Solana、Base 和 XLayer 等 12 条区块链上的 200 多个链上交易场所，交易数据在成交后约一秒即可提供。该数据源覆盖去中心化交易所的现货交易，以及 Hyperliquid 和 Lighter 上的永续合约交易，并以标准化格式提供价格、成交规模和交易明细数据。

Dune 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Fredrik Haga 表示，多数机构首先关注链上市场，因为"没有这些数据，他们已经无法为这些资产正确定价"，意指市场数据是机构参与链上市场的入口。此次发布正值代币化股票市场快速扩张并面临日益严格审视之际。

Haga 表示，首批客户包括量化基金、做市商、资产管理机构和银行交易台，但以保密协议为由拒绝透露具体名称。据 Dune 介绍，这些机构使用该数据评估流动性、比较不同场所的价格，并在投入资金前评估交易策略。
summary.en:
Dune announced on Thursday that it has launched real-time market data feeds covering more than 200 onchain trading venues across 12 blockchains, including Ethereum, Solana, Base and XLayer, delivering trade data roughly one second after execution. The feeds cover spot trading on decentralized exchanges as well as perpetual futures on Hyperliquid and Lighter, with standardized data on prices, trade sizes and transaction details.

Dune co-founder and CEO Fredrik Haga said most institutions are watching onchain markets first because "they can't price these assets properly without them anymore," pointing to market data as the entry point for institutional onchain participation. The launch comes as tokenized stock markets expand and face growing scrutiny.

Haga said quant funds, market makers, asset managers and bank trading desks are among the first clients, but declined to identify them, citing nondisclosure agreements. According to Dune, these firms use the data to assess liquidity, compare prices across venues and evaluate trading strategies before committing capital.

title.zh: a16z 从名称中移除“Crypto”，将投资范围扩大至 AI 与前沿科技
title.en: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech

summary.zh:
安德森·霍洛维茨（Andreessen Horowitz，简称 a16z）将其加密基金“a16z Crypto”更名为“a16z Frontier”，把投资范围扩大到人工智能、生物、硬件等长周期技术领域，同时表示将继续投资加密项目并推动加密监管倡导。该变动于周四通过发送给公司新闻邮件订阅者的邮件公布，基金由 Chris Dixon 与 Marc Andreessen、Ben Horowitz、Eddy Lazzarin 和 Guy Wuollet 共同领导。

a16z 是加密行业最大的投资方之一；按报道的说法，这样规模的机构把“crypto”从名称中去掉，显示出它预期下一波资金可能流向何处。

a16z 称此举是“一次扩展”，并强调加密业务保留：“我们将继续投资加密及相关项目，并倡导合理的加密监管。”相关文章未披露更名后基金的规模，公开记录中的最新数字是 5 月宣布的 22 亿美元。
summary.en:
Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund "a16z Crypto" to "a16z Frontier," widening its mandate to AI, biology, hardware and other long-horizon technologies while saying it will keep investing in crypto and advocating for crypto regulation. The change was disclosed in an email to the firm's newsletter subscribers on Thursday, with Chris Dixon leading the fund alongside Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Eddy Lazzarin and Guy Wuollet.

a16z is among the largest backers of the crypto industry, and as the report frames it, a firm of that size dropping "crypto" from its name shows where it may expect the next wave of capital to go.

The firm calls the move "an expansion" and says crypto stays: "we will continue to invest in crypto and related ventures and advocate for sensible crypto regulation." The post gave no size for the renamed fund; the latest figure on record is the $2.2 billion announced in May.
